unit.why: A passage quoted from the author's introduction (Komarno, 'עוד שם') that reports, in heavily abbreviated form, a heavenly revelation to R. Zvi of Zhidachov and the author's visit to R. Israel of Ruzhin; the narrative core is thin.
unit.boundary_note: part of a run of numbered excerpts from the same introduction; the next division continues the introduction

stories.start_quote: אמר מו״ר דודי רבינו צבי הקדוש
stories.end_quote: והי׳ יודע ברוח קדשו הכל כאשר
stories.summary_en: The author reports that heaven revealed to his uncle R. Zvi that a soul greater than the Ari's and the Besht's exists in this world, which R. Naftali of Ropshitz also said; R. Israel of Ruzhin hinted the same when the author visited him and knew everything by holy spirit.
